research_question: After the retained v3 U.S.-closure mechanism and small v4 HKMA China-FX increment, does same-contract SGX FTSE China A50 futures price discovery while A shares are closed add causal information about the next CSI1000 reopening gap?
financial_rationale: SGX FTSE China A50 futures are a directly China-linked instrument that can trade while mainland A shares are closed. The relevant information is the price move of the same futures contract between the previous A-share close and the target A-share opening auction, not a rolled continuous series and not a generic foreign equity proxy.

data_contract.market_data_provider: Singapore Exchange official historical derivatives endpoint at links.sgx.com

navigation_index.role: date-to-SGX-file-key navigation only; it supplies no market prices

data_contract.market_rows_used: only official SGX CN futures tick records
data_contract.raw_archive_policy: official zip archives may be ephemeral because of size; each used archive URL/key/SHA256 and extraction counts must be frozen in the manifest, while the compact extracted A50 research endpoints must be committed to this repository

event_scope.activation: existing holiday_reopen == 1 in the bounded China panel
event_scope.reason: v2-v3 already localized the closure mechanism to long A-share reopenings; this v5 study tests a preregistered additional causal channel for that mechanism, not a generic everyday A50 factor
event_scope.status_caveat: the 2019-2020 holdout has already been consumed by prior diagnostics, so this layer can create progression material only and cannot authorize a production holiday route or fresh-OOS claim

contract_selection.selection_time: previous China trading date at or before 15:00:00 Singapore/Beijing time
contract_selection.eligible_records: CN futures records with Msg_Code=T and trade time <=15:00:00
contract_selection.rule: among contract month-years with at least one eligible trade, select the chronologically nearest delivery month-year that is not earlier than the previous China calendar month
contract_selection.missing_target_same_contract: mark event unavailable; do not switch contracts

a50_holiday_closure_return.start: last trade of selected contract at or before previous China date 15:00:00
a50_holiday_closure_return.end: last trade of the same contract at or before target China date 09:24:59

a50_holiday_preopen_return.start: first trade of the same selected contract at or after target China date 09:00:00 and at or before 09:24:59
a50_holiday_preopen_return.purpose: separate same-morning regional price discovery from the whole mainland-closure move

price_normalization.reason: older tab-delimited SGX tick files encode CN price in integer hundredths whereas later CSV files carry ordinary decimal index points
price_normalization.frozen_rule: parse CN price numerically; if raw numeric price >100000, divide by 100 exactly once; otherwise keep as reported

data_quality_gates_before_model.if_gate_fails: do not run or adjudicate v5

adjudication.V5A_progression: must improve full-holdout IC and full-holdout SSE versus v4, and improve SSE on available holiday events; report 2019 and 2020 separately
adjudication.V5B_progression_over_V5A: must further improve full-holdout IC and SSE versus V5A and improve holiday-event SSE; otherwise retain V5A if it passed
adjudication.sign_hit: must be reported and must not deteriorate by more than 1 percentage point versus its comparator
adjudication.holiday_leave_one_event_out: run only on the selected v5 progression candidate after fixed predictions are produced; every leave-one-event-out case must be reported, not used for reselection

forbidden: continuous-contract roll joins inside an event
A50 ticks at or after 09:25:00 target-day
A-share target opening or auction result features
